primary.citation: Puglielli & Cabdallah Cumar Mansuur. 1997. Grammatica della lingua somala per le scuole medie superiori, section 6.3.2.1, grammar pp. 97-98 (PDF pp. 98-99); John I. Saeed. 1999. Somali, section 4.3.4.3 Past simple, p. 86.
primary.evidence: The already-reviewed Conjugation-2 morphophonology records Puglielli & Cabdallah Cumar Mansuur's explicit 2SG past waad joogi-s-ay, decomposed as joogi+t+ay, together with the rule that t changes to s after an i-final stem. The same reviewed rule records kari+t+ay as a C2A example of that assibilation. Saeed's explicit C2A past-simple table independently supplies the already-active plural cells 2PL kariseen and 3PL kariyeen. These development facts were present in the repository before v15 target selection and answer lookup; no v15 answer surface is used as runtime evidence.

independent_corroboration.citation: Zorc et al. Somali textbook, Chapter 11 Second Conjugation Verbs, p. 85; GiellaLT Somali morphophonology documentation.
independent_corroboration.evidence: The C2A kari paradigm independently prints second-person singular karisey/karisay, second-person plural kariseen, and third-person plural kariyeen, and explicitly describes the second-conjugation t-to-s change in the 2SG/3SGF cells. This corroborates the class mechanics without using buuxisay or any other v15 answer source.

first_plural_independent.citation: Martin Orwin. 1995. Colloquial Somali: A Complete Language Course. Routledge.
first_plural_independent.evidence: Orwin independently gives C2A kari 1PL past karinnay and describes the first-person-plural n as geminated in this weak-causative pattern. Runtime authorization therefore uses agreement n plus past ay together with the already-reviewed i+n -> inn process. This development fact is distinct from the frozen v16 Green 2021 answer row; buubinnay is never used to author the rule. Orwin's frozen v6 answer rows are also not used as runtime evidence.
first_plural_independent.benchmark_boundary: v16 Green 2021 buubinnay remains evaluation-only; v6 benchmark answers remain evaluation-only

benchmark_isolation.note: The 1PL rule is authorized from independent Orwin development evidence for kari -> karinnay plus the already-reviewed i+n -> inn process. Frozen v16 buubinnay remains evaluation-only. bushi and butaaci remain unresolved as attestation evidence even though the generic rule can mechanically generate analysis candidates. All eleven activated C2A class lemmas receive the same narrow 1PL/2SG/2PL/3PL past authority, with no target-specific profile or correction authority.

notes: Narrow generic C2A class-level past activation. It authorizes 1PL, 2SG, 2PL and 3PL only. 1PL uses agreement n plus past ay with the reviewed weak-causative i+n -> inn alternation; 2SG uses reviewed i+t assibilation with past ay; 2PL uses stem + s + een; 3PL uses the reviewed i-vowel glide before een. Other past persons remain unjudged at class level. Mechanical generated outputs are recognition/analysis candidates only, are not claims of independent attestation, and never receive automatic correction authority.
